🗳️ US HR 9890 — Your town could have more polling places

This bill demands that states and local election officials provide at least one polling place or vote center for every 2,000 registered voters in a state for Federal elections.

These locations can't be clustered together and must be spread out across diverse areas.

States that let people vote by mail or drop box are exempt.

The bill also requires adequate staffing at these locations to process ballots quickly and securely, considering voter numbers and accessibility needs.

Finally, a grant program is established to help states meet these new polling place standards.

July 22, 2026: Referred to the House Committee on House Administration.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/9890
